assets.name: Spock.js
assets.summary: Zero-dependency TypeScript mathematics library providing vectors, matrices, quaternions, geometry primitives, interpolation, and deterministic random number generation for games and WebGL engines.
capabilities: 2D, 3D, and 4D vector and matrix algebra (Vec2, Vec3, Vec4, Mat3, Mat4, Quat)
Geometric primitives, rays, planes, bounding boxes, and frustum math
Deterministic seeded pseudo-random number generation and noise helpers
Zero-allocation in-place vector and matrix operations for hot loops

assets.name: BumpR.js
assets.summary: 2D physics, collision detection, raycasting, and spatial broadphase engine written in TypeScript on top of Spock.js.
capabilities: 2D AABB, circle, line segment, and polygon collision detection and resolution
Spatial grid and broadphase queries for fast entity collision culling
2D raycasting, line-of-sight, and sweep tests against level geometry
Kinematic and dynamic body movement with sliding wall response

assets.name: LoopR.js

capabilities: RequestAnimationFrame loop lifecycle management (start, stop, pause, resume)
Delta-time clock, FPS measurement, and frame-rate capping
Fixed-timestep accumulator with render interpolation alpha
Adaptive quality scaler responding to frame-time budgets

assets.name: RoostR.js
assets.summary: WebGL 3D and 2D rendering engine written in TypeScript with scene graph, camera controllers, procedural texture/material pipelines, mesh builders, and post-processing shaders.
capabilities: WebGL scene graph, perspective/orthographic cameras, and draw call batching
3D primitive and custom mesh builders, skeletal/hierarchical transforms, and billboarding
Procedural texture atlas generation, surface stamps, and custom GLSL shader materials
Post-processing render passes, framebuffers, HUD overlay rendering, and particle systems
